label: The four layers of a formal engine
section: The four layers of a formal engine
subgoals: Place propagation, conflict analysis and proof logging in the core
Place heuristics such as decision, restart and generalization in the policy layer
Place tunable values in parameters and progress data in hooks

label: Which tier a request lands in
section: Which tier a request lands in
subgoals: Map value changes to Tier 1 configuration
Map new strategies at an existing seam to Tier 2 plug-ins
Map changes to soundness-critical code to Tier 3 with human approval

label: Certificates as golden checks
subgoals: Check UNSAT answers with DRAT proofs and an independent checker
Replay counterexamples and re-check returned invariants
Resolve solver disagreements by validating each side's certificate
